definitions.gloss: artistic style, creative style, style of work
definitions.explanation: The distinctive manner or approach characteristic of a particular artist, writer, filmmaker, or other creative person. Refers to the consistent qualities that define their body of work.

examples.japanese: {独特|どくとく}な{作風|さくふう}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Known for a distinctive artistic style.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{作風|さくふう}は{年|とし}とともに{変|か}わってきた。
examples.english: His creative style has changed over the years.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}{監督|かんとく}の{作風|さくふう}は{暗|くら}くて{重|おも}いテーマが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This film director's style tends toward dark and heavy themes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {作|さく} (work, creation) + {風|ふう} (style, manner). The suffix {風|ふう} appears in many style-related words: {画風|がふう} (painting style), {芸風|げいふう} (performance style), {社風|しゃふう} (company culture).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独特|どくとく}な{作風|さくふう} (distinctive style)
- {作風|さくふう}が{変|か}わる (style changes)
- ～{的|てき}な{作風|さくふう} (~-style creative approach)
- {作風|さくふう}を{確立|かくりつ}する (to establish one's style)
